body.heading: Where in the world is Chile?
paragraphs: Chile is a country in South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Chile is Santiago.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Chile is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Chile is the Chilean peso.

body.heading: How big is Chile?
paragraphs: Chile covers about 756,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Paraguay.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: The Atacama Desert in northern Chile is one of the driest nonpolar deserts on Earth. Some weather stations in the Atacama have never recorded rain at all. Its skies are so clear that the world's biggest telescopes watch the stars from its hills.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Torres del Paine's granite towers rise over turquoise lakes and guanaco herds — Patagonia's crown jewel of hiking and wild weather.
The Atacama is the driest non-polar desert on Earth — salt flats with flamingos, geysers at dawn and the clearest stargazing skies anywhere.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Chile on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
